claim_boundary: A frozen, incomplete archive of the deprecated AskFRED v1 public API. The archive advertises 192,939 round objects but contains 192,533 unique round IDs after identical pagination overlap is removed; missing pages are not reconstructed. Every source bout ID is counted once. Names, federation IDs, birth years, clubs, venues, addresses, comments, fees, and raw source IDs are absent from the normalized table. Byes, empty bracket placeholders, tied scores, nonstandard statuses, team events, unknown weapons, and score/status conflicts remain auditable but are excluded from individual outcome training. This is a historical community archive, not an official live USA Fencing feed, a complete participation census, or permission to republish the underlying rows.
grouping_rule: Hold out complete tournaments or competitors. All rounds and bouts from one event remain in one split; presentation side must be randomized inside each fold.
license: No repository or underlying data license. The archivist expressly disclaims ownership; source files and normalized row-level derivatives remain local.
